title: HOSTILE STANDALONE CLOSURE / LOCATOR / NEGATIVE-REFERENCE FEEDER
principal_ruling: Reference minimization may remove repeated payload copies but may not remove interpretation-critical positive, negative, authority, permission, source-universe, query/measure, temporal-limit, role/cardinality/order or producer-identity closure. Each indispensable dependency must be packaged immutable content or exactly immutable/content-addressed/hash-bound resolvable. Broken or ambiguous closure fails closed; V558 may verify/link/index but may not repair semantics.

MUST_PACKAGE_ADMINISTRATIVE_INTEGRITY: V557 publication bundle/manifest identities and hashes
CAN-003 item governance records and collection manifests
transitive semantic closure/reference graph manifest and per-root digests
V558 repository bundle manifest and identity/content hashes
PACKAGE_OR_EXACT_IMMUTABLE_HASH_BOUND_RE: operation-specific source relation/linkage/pooling/composition authority when claimed
exact C11 content/replay identity as required by the claimed replay level
AUDIT_ONLY_NONSEMANTIC: ReplayReceipt except where required to verify a governed replay claim
incidental provenance/audit references not declared interpretation-critical by producer/reference-contract authority

required_invariants: producer semantic IDs/hashes remain canonical; locator/index IDs are nonsemantic
every strong reference resolves exactly or fails missing/ambiguous
semantic edge role/requiredness/participant role/cardinality/multiplicity/order survive closure
genuinely n-ary producer meaning remains n-ary
producer semantic order survives when order_significant=true
packaging integrity failure is never rewritten as producer missing/negative/valid-empty state
repository membership/index hit/global readiness never grants permission
reference accessibility does not inherit root runtime permission
source universes remain distinct absent exact operation-specific composition authority
provenance reachability never grants pooling/linkage/composition authority
PSEPF and reverse-lane objects are rejected from StructuralPriorRepository
raw producer directories, network, mutable latest/current/default, fuzzy/LLM/embedding repair are forbidden
ContextResolver never synthesizes missing V556 relation/topology from co-resolution
same exact repository/query/policy/bindings produce the same semantic result and replay hashes

replay_claim_separation.standalone_v558_structural_resolution: May pass without embedding respondent microdata when exact structural producer semantics and interpretation-critical authority/provenance resolve immutably with raw producer stage directories absent.
replay_claim_separation.full_offline_empirical_replay: Requires exact historical C11 content/material or an immutable content-addressed resolver plus exact risk-set/measure/authority inputs; a content hash alone does not prove replay availability.

proposed_parent_requirements: Adopt a corrected reference-class registry that marks every exact producer family/dependency class as root/reference-only/audit-only/must-not-appear.
Require per-root typed transitive semantic closure digests covering edge role/cardinality/multiplicity/order and negative dependencies.
Require locator reversibility to exact producer tuple and hash verification before index-selected objects become candidates.
Require item-wise CAN-003 permission monotonicity through V558 resolver selection.
Require source-universe and operation-specific composition authorities to remain exact and noninferable from provenance.
Require explicit separation of structural standalone resolution claims from full offline empirical replay claims.
Run the hostile fixtures against final SCR553/554/555/556 producer contracts at M4 and peer-prior/PSEPF boundary at M5.
unresolved_parent_owned_items: final exact producer-family/reference-class registry after SCR553/554/555/556 contracts are accepted
final V557 runtime-use governance schema and policy rule set
exact storage engine and file/layout mechanics
M4 and M5 final seam adjudication
